top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises one testable idea, induced proximity to an E3 ligase turning drug action from occupancy into catalytic removal, through the PROTAC concept (Crews, Deshaies) and the cereblon mechanism (Handa). It has been reproduced for two decades and the glue strand already underlies approved medicines. The costs are real: Sakamoto and Ciulli are omitted, no bifunctional degrader is approved, and the two strands have different histories. I still rank it first because it is the broadest, most transformative achievement on the slate, and P002 (Buchwald and Hartwig) is the mature, cleanly attributed fallback if the cut is judged indefensible.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; institutional tie to Lund colleagues Somfai and Sparr only, no documented tie to any credited laureate
